headline: Princess Margaret Cancer Foundation Receives $100M Anonymous Gift
meta_description: The Princess Margaret Cancer Foundation has received a transformative $100 million donation from an anonymous benefactor, marking a significant boost to cancer…
summary_short: An anonymous donor has given $100 million to the Princess Margaret Cancer Foundation, one of the largest gifts in the organization's history.
body:
The Princess Margaret Cancer Foundation has received a $100 million donation from an anonymous donor, marking a major moment for the organization's mission to advance cancer care and research.

The scale of the gift underscores the growing momentum behind cancer research funding. Anonymous donations of this magnitude are relatively rare, yet they reflect deep individual commitment to medical causes—often from donors whose philanthropic work speaks louder than their names.

The contribution arrives as cancer organizations worldwide continue expanding treatment options and research capabilities. For the Princess Margaret Cancer Foundation, the infusion of resources opens new possibilities for accelerating clinical work and supporting patients facing one of the world's most pressing health challenges.
quick_facts: $100 million donated to Princess Margaret Cancer Foundation
Gift comes from an anonymous single donor
One of the largest donations in the foundation's history
